arxiv-2107-12000.title: Probing the in-medium P T P_{T} -broadening by γ \gamma +HF angular de-correlations
arxiv-2107-12000.creator: Sa Wang, Jin-Wen Kang, Wei Dai, Ben-Wei Zhang, Enke Wang
arxiv-2107-12000.description: Abstract Angular correlations between vector boson and heavy flavors (HF) are potentially new effective tools to gain insight into the partonic interactions in the quark-gluon plasma (QGP). In this paper, we present the theoretical study of the azimuthal angular de-correlations of γ + \gamma+ HF in nucleus-nucleus collisions as a new probe of the in-medium P T P_{T} -broadening effect.

arxiv-2208-11539.title: Bulk renormalization and the AdS/CFT correspondence
arxiv-2208-11539.creator: Máximo Bañados ∗ , Ernesto Bianchi ∗† , Iván Muñoz ∗† and Kostas Skenderis †
arxiv-2208-11539.description: Abstract We develop a systematic renormalization procedure for QFT in anti-de Sitter spacetime. UV infinities are regulated using a geodesic point-splitting method, which respects AdS isometries, while IR infinities are regulated by cutting off the radial direction (as in holographic renormalization).

arxiv-2303-01514.title: Control flow in active inference systems
arxiv-2303-01514.creator: Chris Fields, Filippo Fabrocini, Karl Friston, James F. Glazebrook, Hananel Hazan, Michael Levin and Antonino Marcianò
arxiv-2303-01514.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chris Fields, Filippo Fabrocini, Karl Friston, James F. Glazebrook, Hananel Hazan, Michael Levin and Antonino Marcianò. Abstract Living systems face both environmental complexity and limited access to free-energy resources. Survival under these conditions requires a control system that can activate, or deploy, available perception and action resources in a context specific way.

arxiv-2310-04184.title: Preservation of 3 {}^{3}\mkern-2.0mu He ion polarization after laser-plasma acceleration
arxiv-2310-04184.creator: C. Zheng, P. Fedorets, R. Engels, I. Engin, H. Glückler, C. Kannis, N. Schnitzler, H. Soltner, Z. Chitgar, P. Gibbon, L. Reichwein, A. Pukhov, B. Zielbauer, M. Büscher
arxiv-2310-04184.description: Abstract The preservation of nuclear spin alignment in plasmas is a prerequisite for important applications, such as energy production through polarized fusion or the acceleration of polarized particle beams. Although this conservation property has been the basis of numerous theoretical papers, it has never been experimentally confirmed. Here, we report on first experimental data from a polarized 3 {}^{3}\mkern-2.

arxiv-2509-26166.title: Beyond Overall Accuracy: Pose- and Occlusion-driven Fairness Analysis in Pedestrian Detection for Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2509-26166.creator: Mohammad Khoshkdahan, Arman Akbari, Arash Akbari, Xuan Zhang
arxiv-2509-26166.description: Abstract Pedestrian detection plays a critical role in autonomous driving (AD), where ensuring safety and reliability is important. While many detection models aim to reduce miss-rates and handle challenges such as occlusion and long-range recognition, fairness remains an underexplored yet equally important concern.

arxiv-2511-09140.title: LMMSE-Optimal Pilot Pattern Design Based on Covariance Matrix Approximation for OFDM Channel Estimation in Doubly Dispersive Channel Thanks: The work is partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (62571467, 62201162).
arxiv-2511-09140.creator: Xuyao Yu, Zijun Gong, Zhilu Lai
arxiv-2511-09140.description: Abstract This paper investigates the optimal pilot pattern design, in the linear minimum mean square error (LMMSE) estimator sense, for OFDM systems in doubly dispersive channels. To enable analytical tractability, the channel covariance matrix is decomposed into the Kronecker product of two Hermitian Toeplitz matrices corresponding to the delay and Doppler domains.

pmc-10536700.title: Stress responses of plants through transcriptome plasticity by mRNA alternative polyadenylation
pmc-10536700.creator: Jiawen Zhou, Qingshun Quinn Li
pmc-10536700.description: The sessile nature of plants confines their responsiveness to changing environmental conditions. Gene expression regulation becomes a paramount mechanism for plants to adjust their physiological and morphological behaviors. Alternative polyadenylation (APA) is known for its capacity to augment transcriptome diversity and plasticity, thereby furnishing an additional set of tools for modulating gene expression.

pmc-10572964.title: Active Lifestyle and Mobility of Adults with Vision Impairment: A Multiphase Mixed-Methods Study
pmc-10572964.creator: Deborah Barasche-Berdah, Ora Paltiel, Raanan Raz, Paul B Tchounwou
pmc-10572964.description: Individuals with vision impairment (VI) are less physically active than their sighted peers, heightening their risk of chronic illness. This study aimed to explore real and perceived barriers and promoters of an active lifestyle among adults with VI. We used mixed-methods, including a quantitative analysis of spatial data and a qualitative analysis of input from focus groups.

pmc-10750650.title: Foot and Ankle Offset in the Setting of Severe Rotational Foot and Ankle Deformities
pmc-10750650.creator: Ryan Jasper, Hannah J. Stebral, Vineel Mallavarapu, Grayson M. Talaski, Eli Schmidt, Aly M. Fayed, Ki Chun Kim, Kepler A.M. Carvalho, Nacime Salomao Barbachan Mansur, Cesar de Cesar Netto
pmc-10750650.description: Category:Ankle; HindfootIntroduction/Purpose:Foot and Ankle Offset (FAO) is a clinically relevant measurement technique used to objectively evaluate the foot and ankle that has been shown to be reliable and validated in common mild foot deformities. It represents a measurement of the offset between the body weight vector and the ground reaction force vector, thus making it a biomechanically relevant measurement.

pmc-13146955.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1529 SOVATELTIDE (TYCAMZZI®) HAS NO EFFECT ON THE THROMBOLYTIC ACTIVITY OF CLOT LYSIS DRUGS
pmc-13146955.creator: Manish Subhashrao Lavhale, Amaresh Ranjan, Dharmesh Shah, Anil Gulati
pmc-13146955.description: Background and aimsAlteplase and tenecteplase are widely used to lyse the clot in patients with acute cerebral ischemic stroke (ACIS). Sovateltide (Tycamzzi®), a novel endothelin B receptor agonist, is being marketed in India and is undergoing phase 3 clinical trials (RESPECT-ETB) in the USA, Germany, Spain, Australia, and the UK for the treatment of ACIS.

pmc-13556437.title: 859. From Neurons to Behavior: Preclinical Insights into LSD’s Anxiolytic Mechanisms
pmc-13556437.creator: G Gobbi
pmc-13556437.description: BackgroundLysergic acid diethylamide (LSD), a serotonergic psychedelic, has gained renewed interest for its potential anxiolytic effects in clinical trials. However, the neurobiological mechanisms underlying these effects remain poorly understood.Aims & ObjectivesThe goal of this study is to understand the mechanism of action of LSD in animal models by using in vivo electrophysiology and behavioral paradigms.
